# Copilot Instructions for `KingShadP/KSP-`

## Repository reality

- This repository is currently in initialization state.
- There is no app framework, package manager lockfile, build config, or test suite yet.

## Non-negotiables

- Preserve authentic KingShadP materials whenever they are introduced.
- Never replace custom authored work with generic artist/store templates.
- Never fabricate brand assets, biography facts, music catalog facts, awards, stats, or collaborations.
- Never create substitute logos or redesign official marks (wordmark, KSP monogram, SP crest, Giragon).

## Implementation behavior

- Before coding, inspect current files and infer stack from actual repository contents.
- Keep changes surgical and additive; avoid broad rewrites.
- Introduce architecture that supports identity, music, visual archive, digital experiments, and selected commerce as connected systems.
- Respect accessibility, responsive behavior, performance, and reduced-motion preferences.

## Documentation expectations

- Keep `README.md` aligned with actual stack and commands present in the repo.
- When tooling is added, document install/dev/build/lint/typecheck/test commands and env var names (never secret values).

## Asset and media handling

- Do not overwrite source-quality media with compressed replacements.
- Optimize delivery responsibly (responsive images, lazy-loading, critical media prioritization) once the runtime stack exists.
